slides.headline: Meta said 10 sales. Shopify said 6.
slides.text: Nobody was lying. Here is what actually happened.

slides.headline: Your pixel fires *twice* for one buyer.
slides.text: The browser sends a purchase. Your server sends the same purchase. Meta is supposed to match them and count one.

slides.headline: Some of those sales are *estimates*.
slides.text: Since iOS 14, Meta models conversions it cannot observe. Modelled sales look identical to real ones.

slides.headline: Stop trying to make them match.
slides.text: They measure different things. Which one does your team quote in meetings?
